createTable.remarks: A promotion placement of any owning entity: which entry is lifted out of the catalog and why. One writer owns each reason's rows; no column on the promoted entity's own table. Same entity_type+entity_id convention as contact_info and audit_log, no DB-level FK, resolved only via PromotionPlacementPort, never a SQL join.

column.name: entity_type
column.remarks: Promoted entity type (EntityType; PROVIDER_PROFILE today), resolved via PromotionPlacementPort, not a join

column.name: entity_id
column.remarks: ID of the promoted entity. References provider_profile(id), no FK

column.name: reason
column.remarks: Why the entry is promoted (PromotionReason, TOP_RATED today). Each value has exactly one writer that owns and replaces its rows
